en.s: The Battle of Toulouse (721) was a victory of an Aquitanian Christian army led by Odo the Great, Duke of Aquitaine over an Umayyad Muslim army besieging the city of Toulouse, led by al-Samh ibn Malik al-Khawlani, the Umayyad wāli (governor-general) of al-Andalus. The decisive Aquitanian victory checked the spread of Umayyad control westward from Narbonne into Aquitaine.

zh.s: 721年图卢兹战役中，阿基坦公爵奥多率领的阿基坦基督教军队击败了由安达卢斯总督阿斯·萨姆赫·伊本·马利克·豪拉尼率领、正在围攻图卢兹的倭马亚军队。这场胜利遏制了倭马亚势力从纳博讷向西扩张至阿基坦。

en.s: (For other conflicts at Langensalza, see Battle of Langensalza (disambiguation).) The First Battle of Langensalza was fought on 9 June 1075 between forces of King Henry IV of Germany and several rebellious Saxon noblemen on the River Unstrut near Langensalza in Thuringia. The battle was a complete success for Henry, resulting in the subjugation of the Saxons shortly before the Investiture Controversy commenced. In Germany the battle is known as the Schlacht bei Homburg an der Unstrut, after a nearby Kaiserpfalz and monastery.

zh.s: 第一次朗根萨尔察战役于1075年6月9日爆发，交战双方是德国国王亨利四世的军队与数名叛乱的萨克森贵族，战场位于图林根州朗根萨尔察附近的温斯特鲁特河畔。亨利大获全胜，迫使萨克森人屈服；不久后，叙任权斗争爆发。在德国，这场战役称为“温斯特鲁特河畔洪堡战役”，名称来自附近的一座皇宫和修道院。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Pol-de-Léon was a minor action during the Breton War of Succession and thus part of the larger Hundred Years War. The battle was fought in June 1346 and marked a minor turning point in the fortunes of the Montfortists and their English allies in Brittany following several setbacks including the imprisonment and subsequent death of their leader, John of Montfort.

zh.s: 圣波勒德莱昂之战是布列塔尼继承战争中的一场小规模战斗，也属于更广泛的百年战争。战斗发生于1346年6月。此前蒙福尔派及其英国盟友在布列塔尼接连受挫，包括领袖让·德·蒙福尔被俘及随后去世；这场战斗使他们的处境稍有转机。

en.s: The Battle of the Cahul was a military engagement took place 9 June 1574 at the Cahul Lake during the Moldavian Revolt. The Ottoman-Crimean army fight against Moldavian-Cossack forces and defeat them. After the rebellious voevoda of Moldavia, John the Terrible, was able to win a series of victories over the Turkish troops, a large Turkish army went to suppress his rebellion, which, thanks to the betrayal by several Moldavian nobles, was able to completely destroy the enemy.

zh.s: 卡胡尔湖战役于1574年6月9日在摩尔达维亚起义期间爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼—克里米亚联军与摩尔达维亚—哥萨克部队。奥斯曼—克里米亚联军获胜。摩尔达维亚反叛总督“暴君”约翰此前多次击败土耳其军队，随后一支规模庞大的土军前来镇压起义。由于数名摩尔达维亚贵族叛变，土军得以彻底击败对手。

en.s: The Taking of Diest (9 June 1580) was a successful surprise assault on the town of Diest, in the Duchy of Brabant, during the Dutch Revolt.

zh.s: 迪斯特突袭发生于1580年6月9日，是荷兰起义期间对布拉班特公国迪斯特镇发动的一次成功突袭。

en.s: The Siege of Salses (1639–1640) was a double siege during the Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659), starting with a French success, but ending by a Spanish victory. First, a French army of 16,000 men under Henri, Prince of Condé besieged the castle held by 600 Spanish from 9 June 1639. After a siege of 40 days, the Spanish garrison surrendered on 19 July.But 6 weeks later a large Spanish army of 24,000 men, mainly Catalans, under Filippo Spinola appeared and now besieged the French garrison of 2,000 men.

zh.s: 萨尔斯围城战（1639—1640年）是法西战争期间的两次围城战，先由法国获胜，最终以西班牙获胜告终。首先，孔代亲王亨利率领1.6万名法军，于1639年6月9日起围攻由600名西班牙守军把守的城堡。围城40天后，西班牙守军于7月19日投降。六周后，菲利波·斯皮诺拉率领一支2.4万人的西班牙大军（主要由加泰罗尼亚人组成）抵达，转而围攻2,000名法军守军。

en.s: The Afghan Durrani Empire, led by Ahmad Shah Durrani, fought a campaign in Khorasan between 1769 and 1770, against Afsharid Iran. It was his third Khorasan campaign, after those of 1749–1751 and 1754–1755.

zh.s: 1769年至1770年，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼率领阿富汗杜兰尼王朝军队在呼罗珊对阿夫沙尔王朝伊朗作战。这是他继1749—1751年和1754—1755年两次战役后的第三次呼罗珊战役。

en.s: The Gaspee affair was a significant event in the lead-up to the American Revolution. HMS Gaspee was a Royal Navy revenue schooner that enforced the Navigation Acts around Newport, Rhode Island, in 1772. It ran aground in shallow water while chasing the packet boat Hannah on June 9 off Warwick, Rhode Island. A group of men led by Abraham Whipple and John Brown attacked, boarded, and burned the Gaspee to the waterline.

zh.s: 加斯比号事件是美国独立战争前夕的重要事件。1772年，英国皇家海军税务纵帆船“加斯比”号在罗得岛纽波特附近执行《航海法案》。1772年6月9日，该船追逐邮船“汉娜”号时在罗得岛沃里克附近浅滩搁浅。一群由亚伯拉罕·惠普尔和约翰·布朗带领的人袭击并登上“加斯比”号，随后将其烧至船体水线。

en.s: The Battle of Arlon (9 June 1793) saw a French Republican force under the command of Amable Henri Delaage face a Habsburg Austrian force led by Gottfried von Schröder. The French were victorious though they suffered higher casualties than the Austrians. The action was fought during the War of the First Coalition, part of the larger French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 阿尔隆战役于1793年6月9日爆发，阿马布尔·亨利·德拉阿热指挥的法国共和军与戈特弗里德·冯·施罗德率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军交战。法国获胜，但伤亡人数高于奥军。战斗发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间；这场战争属于更广泛的法国大革命战争。

en.s: The Battle of Saintfield was a short but bloody clash in County Down, Northern Ireland. The battle was the first major conflict of the Irish Rebellion of 1798 in Down. The battle took place on Saturday, 9 June 1798.

zh.s: 圣菲尔德战役是北爱尔兰唐郡发生的一场短暂但血腥的冲突，也是1798年爱尔兰起义在唐郡爆发的首场重大交战。战斗于1798年6月9日星期六发生。

en.s: The Battle of Arklow took place during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 on 9 June when a force of United Irishmen from Wexford, estimated at 10,000 strong, launched an assault into County Wicklow, on the British-held town of Arklow, in an attempt to spread the rebellion into Wicklow and to threaten the capital of Dublin.

zh.s: 阿克洛战役发生于1798年6月9日爱尔兰起义期间。来自韦克斯福德、估计有10,000人的爱尔兰联合会军队袭击了英国控制的威克洛郡阿克洛镇，试图将起义扩展到威克洛，并威胁首都都柏林。

en.s: The Battle of Montebello was fought on 9 June 1800 near Montebello in Lombardy. During the lead-up to the Battle of Marengo, the vanguard of the French army in Italy engaged and defeated an Austrian force in a "glorious victory".

zh.s: 蒙特贝洛战役于1800年6月9日在伦巴第的蒙特贝洛附近爆发。马伦戈战役前夕，意大利法军前卫与奥地利军队交战并将其击败，法军称这场胜利“辉煌”。

en.s: The Raid on Oropesa took place on 9 June 1801 off the coast of Spain at Oropesa del Mar, when two Royal Navy brigs; HMS Kangaroo and HMS Speedy attacked the port after chasing an armed Spanish convoy. The two British ships took out a fortification of twelve guns and then sank or drove ashore all of the Spanish ships with the exception of three brigs, which they captured.

zh.s: 奥罗佩萨突袭发生于1801年6月9日，地点在西班牙奥罗佩萨德尔马尔海岸。英国皇家海军两艘双桅帆船“袋鼠”号和“迅捷”号追击一支武装西班牙船队后袭击港口。两艘英舰击毁一座装备12门火炮的防御工事，随后击沉或逼迫所有西班牙船只搁浅，只有三艘双桅帆船被俘。

en.s: The War of the Oranges (Portuguese: Guerra das Laranjas; French: Guerre des Oranges; Spanish: Guerra de las Naranjas) was a brief conflict in 1801 in which Spanish forces, instigated by the government of France, and ultimately supported by the French military, invaded Portugal. The war resulted in the Treaty of Badajoz, the loss of Portuguese territory, in particular losing Olivenza to Spain.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1801年的橘子战争是一场短暂冲突。西班牙军队在法国政府鼓动、后来还有法军支援的情况下入侵葡萄牙。战争以《巴达霍斯条约》告终，葡萄牙失去部分领土，其中包括划归西班牙的奥利文萨。

en.s: The Battle of Saltholm was fought on 9 June 1808 during the Gunboat War. Danish and Norwegian ships attacked a British convoy off the island of Saltholm in Øresund Strait near Copenhagen. A convoy of 70 British merchant vessels left Malmö under the escort of three Royal Navy brigs and one bomb vessel. The brigs were HMS Turbulent of 12 guns, the 14-gun Piercer and the 12-gun HMS Charger.

zh.s: 萨尔特霍尔姆海战于1808年6月9日在炮艇战争期间爆发。丹麦和挪威舰船在哥本哈根附近厄勒海峡的萨尔特霍尔姆岛外袭击了一支英国船队。70艘英国商船在3艘皇家海军双桅帆船和1艘炮舰护航下离开马尔默。三艘双桅帆船分别是“Turbulent”号（12门炮）、“Piercer”号（14门炮）和“Charger”号（12门炮）。

en.s: The Battle of Puente Sanpayo or Battle of San Payo (Galician: Ponte Sampaio) took place at the eponymous bridge in Pontevedra, between 7–9 June 1809 during the Peninsular War. It ended with a Spanish victory achieved by Colonel Pablo Morillo who repelled Marshal Michel Ney's attempt to displace him from a strong riverside position.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣帕约桥战役（又称圣帕约战役）于1809年6月7日至9日在半岛战争期间爆发，地点是蓬特韦德拉的圣帕约桥。西班牙军队在帕布洛·莫里略上校率领下获胜，击退了米歇尔·内伊元帅试图将其赶离河畔坚固阵地的进攻。

en.t: Delegates sign the Final Act of the Congress of Vienna
en.s: Delegates signed the Final Act of the Congress of Vienna in Vienna, Austria, on June 9, 1815. The document brought together agreements negotiated after Napoleon's first defeat and set out a new political order for much of Europe. The congress had met for months; June 9 marks the signing of its final document.
en.n: June 9 is the date of the Final Act's signing, not the start of the Congress of Vienna.

zh.t: 维也纳会议代表签署《最后议定书》
zh.s: 1815年6月9日，各国代表在奥地利维也纳签署维也纳会议《最后议定书》。文件汇集了拿破仑首次战败后各方谈判达成的协议，为欧洲大部分地区确立了新的政治秩序。维也纳会议已持续数月；这一天是最后文件的签署日。
zh.n: 6月9日是《最后议定书》的签署日期，并非维也纳会议开幕日。

en.s: Partial legislative elections were held in Belgium on Tuesday 9 June 1835. In the Senate elections Catholics won 31 seats and Liberals eight. Only 23,000 people were eligible to vote in the election. Under the alternating system, Chamber elections were only held in four out of the nine provinces: East Flanders, Hainaut, Liège and Limburg. Thus, 51 of the 102 Chamber seats were up for election.

zh.s: 比利时于1835年6月9日星期二举行部分立法选举。参议院选举中，天主教派赢得31席，自由派获得8席。只有23,000人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，只有东佛兰德、埃诺、列日和林堡四省举行众议院选举，因此众议院102个席位中有51席改选。

en.s: The 1859 New South Wales colonial election was held between 9 June and 7 July 1859. This election was for all of the 80 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 58 single-member constituencies, seven 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

en.s: The Battle of Port Republic was fought on June 9, 1862, in Rockingham County, Virginia, as part of Confederate Army Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's campaign through the Shenandoah Valley during the American Civil War. Port Republic was a fierce contest between two equally determined foes and was the most costly battle fought by Jackson's Army of the Valley during its campaign. Together, the battles of Cross Keys (fought the previous day) and Port Republic were the decisive victories in Jackson's Valley Campaign, forcing the Union armies to retreat and leaving Jackson free to reinforce Gen. Robert E.

zh.s: 1862年6月9日，美国内战中的波特里帕布利克之战在弗吉尼亚州罗金厄姆县爆发，属于邦联少将“石墙”杰克逊的谢南多厄河谷战役。双方激烈交战，这也是杰克逊河谷部队在该战役中损失最惨重的一仗。前一天的克罗斯基斯之战和这场战斗一起迫使联邦军撤退，使杰克逊得以转而增援罗伯特·E.李将军。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 9 June 1863. The result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 59 of the 116 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 33 of the 58 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 74.5%, although only 52,519 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections for the Chamber of Representatives were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. Additionally, special elections were held in the arrondissements of Tournai, Ghent and Hasselt.

zh.s: 比利时于1863年6月9日举行部分大选。自由党获胜，在众议院116席中赢得59席，在参议院58席中赢得33席。投票率为74.5%，但只有52,519人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，只有安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德五省举行众议院选举。此外，图尔奈、根特和哈瑟尔特选区也举行了特别选举。

en.s: The Battle of Brandy Station, also called the Battle of Fleetwood Hill, was the largest predominantly cavalry engagement of the American Civil War, as well as the largest ever to take place on American soil. It was fought on June 9, 1863, around Brandy Station, Virginia, at the beginning of the Gettysburg Campaign by the Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Alfred Pleasonton against Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart's Confederate cavalry. Pleasonton launched a surprise dawn attack on Stuart's cavalry at Brandy Station. After an all-day fight in which fortunes changed repeatedly, the Federals retired without discovering Gen. Robert E.

zh.s: 布兰迪站之战又称弗利特伍德山之战，是美国内战中规模最大的骑兵战，也是美国本土发生过的最大骑兵战。1863年6月9日，阿尔弗雷德·普莱森顿少将率联邦军骑兵在弗吉尼亚州布兰迪站附近，趁黎明突袭J.E.B.斯图尔特少将的邦联骑兵。双方鏖战一整天，战况数度逆转；联邦军最终撤退，没发现罗伯特·E.李将军的步兵就驻扎在附近的库尔佩珀。

en.s: The battle of Lake Providence occurred in Lake Providence, Louisiana on June 9, 1863, during the siege of Vicksburg in the American Civil War. The battle was meant to be in conjunction with Confederate attacks against Union supply depots at Young's Point and Milliken's Bend on June 7. However the Confederate commander, Lt. Col. Frank Bartlett set out 48 hours behind schedule, but still pushed on toward the Federal garrison. The Union forces were commanded by Brig. Gen. Hugh T. Reid and greatly outnumbered Bartlett. Reid's brigade was a mixed command of white soldiers and United States Colored Troops.

zh.s: 普罗维登斯湖战役于1863年6月9日在路易斯安那州普罗维登斯湖地区爆发，是美国内战期间维克斯堡围城战的一部分。原计划配合6月7日南方邦联军袭击杨斯角和米利肯湾的联邦补给站。南军指挥官弗兰克·巴特利特中校比计划晚了48小时出发，但仍继续向联邦驻军推进。联邦军由休·T·里德准将指挥，人数远多于巴特利特的部队。里德的旅由白人士兵和美国有色人种部队混编组成。

zh.s: 美国内战期间，里士满—彼得斯堡战役于1864年6月9日至1865年3月25日在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡周边展开，包含多场战斗。它通常被称为“彼得斯堡围城战”，但城市并未像传统围城那样被完全包围、切断所有补给线，战事也不只限于彼得斯堡。这场战役包括尤利西斯·S.格兰特中将指挥的联邦军持续九个月的堑壕战。

en.s: The First Battle of Petersburg was an unsuccessful Union assault against the earthworks fortifications—the Dimmock Line—protecting the city of Petersburg, Virginia, June 9, 1864, during the American Civil War. Because of the rag-tag group of defenders involved, it is sometimes known as the Battle of Old Men and Young Boys.

zh.s: 第一次彼得堡战役是联邦军于1864年6月9日对保护弗吉尼亚州彼得堡的土木防线——迪莫克防线——发起的一次失败进攻，发生在美国内战期间。由于守军临时拼凑，这场战役有时也称“老人和男孩之战”。

en.s: The Battle of Marietta was a series of military operations from June 9 through July 3, 1864, in Cobb County, Georgia, between Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War. The Union forces, led by Maj. Gen. William Tecumseh Sherman, encountered the Confederate Army of Tennessee, led by Gen. Joseph E. Johnston, entrenched near Marietta, Georgia.

zh.s: 玛丽埃塔战役是美国内战期间的一系列军事行动，于1864年6月9日至7月3日在佐治亚州科布县爆发，交战双方为联邦军和南方邦联军。威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼少将率领的联邦军遇到约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿将军率领的田纳西邦联军。邦联军在佐治亚州玛丽埃塔附近构筑阵地。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 9 June 1868. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 72 of the 122 seats. Voter turnout was 55.6%, although only 55,297 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders.

zh.s: 比利时于1868年6月9日举行大选。在众议院选举中，自由党获胜，赢得122个席位中的72席。投票率为55.6%，但只有55,297人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，只有安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德五省举行选举。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 9 June 1874. The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 68 of the 124 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 34 of the 62 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 64.1%, although only 52,074 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections for the Chamber of Representatives were only held in four out of the nine provinces: Hainaut, Limburg, Liège and East Flanders. Incumbent Head of Government Barthélémy de Theux de Meylandt was re-elected in the arrondissement of Hasselt but died on 21 August 1874.

zh.s: 比利时于1874年6月9日举行部分大选。天主教党获胜，在众议院124席中赢得68席，在参议院62席中赢得34席。投票率为64.1%，但只有52,074人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，只有埃诺、林堡、列日和东佛兰德四省举行众议院选举。现任政府首脑巴泰勒米·德·特克斯·德·迈朗在哈瑟尔特选区再次当选，但于1874年8月21日去世。

en.s: The Battle of Prairie Dog Creek, also known as the Skirmish at Tongue River Heights, or the Battle of the Tongue River (1876), part of the Great Sioux War of 1876, occurred on June 9, 1876, at the confluence of Prairie Dog Creek and the Tongue River primarily in Wyoming Territory.

zh.s: 草原土拨鼠溪战役又称舌河高地小冲突，是1876年苏族大战的一部分，发生于1876年6月9日，地点在草原土拨鼠溪与舌河交汇处，主要位于怀俄明领地。

en.s: The Treaty of Tianjin (Chinese: 中法新約), signed on June 9, 1885, officially ended the Sino-French War. The "unequal treaty", or colonial treaty, restated in greater detail the main provisions of the Tianjin Accord, signed between France and China on May 11, 1884. As Article 2 required China to recognize the French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin established by the Treaty of Hue in June 1884, implicitly forcing China to abandon its claims to suzerainty over Vietnam, the treaty formalized France's diplomatic victory in the Sino-French War.

zh.s: 《天津条约》（中文：中法新约）于1885年6月9日签署，正式结束中法战争。这份“不平等条约”或殖民条约更详细地重申了1884年5月11日中法签署的《天津协定》的主要条款。第二条要求中国承认法国对安南和东京（北圻）的保护国地位，该地位由1884年6月签订的《顺化条约》确立；这实际上迫使中国放弃对越南的宗主权主张。该条约正式确认了法国在中法战争中的外交胜利。

en.s: The Wanganui by-election of 1893 was a by-election held on 9 June 1893 during the 11th New Zealand Parliament in the central North Island seat of Wanganui. The election was held due to death of sitting Member, Prime Minister John Ballance. The contest for his former seat was won by his longtime friend and business partner Archibald Willis, who received support from the constituents by keeping the "Ballance tradition" alive.

zh.s: 旺格努伊选区于1893年6月9日举行补选，是新西兰第11届议会中北岛中部选区的一次补选。时任议员、总理约翰·巴兰斯去世，导致补选。其长期好友兼商业伙伴阿奇博尔德·威利斯赢得席位；他延续“巴兰斯传统”，获得选民支持。

en.t: Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory
en.s: The Convention between the United Kingdom and China, Respecting an Extension of Hong Kong Territory, commonly known as the Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory or the Second Convention of Peking, was a lease and unequal treaty signed between Qing China and the United Kingdom in Peking on 9 June 1898, leasing to the United Kingdom for 99 years, at no charge, the New Territories (as the area became known) and New Kowloon, including 235 islands.

zh.s: 《中英展拓香港界址专条》通常称《展拓香港界址专条》或《第二次北京条约》，是清朝与英国于1898年6月9日在北京签订的一项租借条约和不平等条约。清政府将新界（该地区后来使用的名称）和新九龙租借给英国99年，不收租金；范围包括235个岛屿。

en.s: The 1900 British Columbia general election was held in 1900. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election was called on April 24, 1900, and held on June 9, 1900. The new legislature met for the first time on July 19, 1900. Like in the previous BC general election, of the 38 MLAs 24 were elected in single member districts in 1900.

zh.s: 不列颠哥伦比亚省于1900年举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。选举于1900年4月24日宣布，并于6月9日举行。新一届议会于1900年7月19日首次开会。与上届省选举一样，38名省议员中有24人在单一议员选区当选。

en.s: The Battle of Hill 383 was a military engagement between the armies of Austria-Hungary and Italy on the Italian front of World War I, lasting from June 1915 to May 1917. The battle took place on a hill later called Mount Prižnica (Italian: Poggio Montanari), located across the river Soča (Italian: Isonzo) from the town of Plave in Austria-Hungary (present-day Slovenia).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战意大利战线上的383高地之战，由奥匈帝国军队和意大利军队交战，从1915年6月持续到1917年5月。战场位于奥匈帝国境内普拉韦镇索查河对岸的一座山丘，后来称为普里日尼察山，今属斯洛文尼亚。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1921 Saskatchewan general election was held on June 9, 1921, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. The Liberal Party of Saskatchewan of Premier William M. Martin was re-elected – although with a diminished share of the popular vote, and a reduced caucus in the legislature. Donald McLean resigned as leader of the Conservative Party in April 1921, and the party convention decided to only form a committee to make arrangements for the coming election.

zh.s: 萨斯喀彻温省于1921年6月9日举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。由省长威廉·M·马丁领导的萨斯喀彻温省自由党再次当选执政党，但得票率和议会党团人数均有所减少。唐纳德·麦克莱恩于1921年4月辞去保守党领袖职务，党大会决定只设立委员会，为即将到来的选举作准备。

en.s: The Bulgarian coup d'état of 1923, also known as the 9 June coup d'état (Bulgarian: Деветоюнски преврат, Devetoyunski prevrat), was a coup d'état in Bulgaria implemented by armed forces under General Ivan Valkov's Military Union on the eve of 9 June 1923. Hestitantly legitimated by a decree of Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria, it overthrew the government of the Bulgarian Agrarian National Union headed by Aleksandar Stamboliyski and replaced it with one under Aleksandar Tsankov.

zh.s: 1923年保加利亚政变也称“六月九日政变”（保加利亚语：Деветоюнски преврат，Devetoyunski prevrat），于1923年6月9日前夕发生。伊万·瓦尔科夫将军领导的军事联盟武装部队发动政变。保加利亚沙皇鲍里斯三世颁布法令，勉强为政变赋予合法性。政变推翻了亚历山大·斯坦博利伊斯基领导的保加利亚农民联盟政府，并由亚历山大·赞科夫领导的新政府取而代之。

en.t: Academia Sinica formally established at its first academy-affairs meeting
en.s: On June 9, 1928, Academia Sinica held its first academy-affairs meeting and was formally established. Cai Yuanpei was its first president, and its general office was based in Nanjing, China.
en.n: This records the formal establishment and first meeting, following earlier preparatory and organisational work.

zh.s: 1928年6月9日，中央研究院召开第一次院务会议，宣告正式成立。蔡元培任首任院长，总办事处设在南京。
zh.n: 此条记录为正式成立及首次院务会议，此前已开展筹备和组织工作。

en.s: The 1929 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on June 9, 1929. Incumbent George E. Cryer chose not contest the election and retire from office, making it the first open seat since 1911. The race was won by John Clinton Porter, who defeated Councilman William G. Bonelli, John R. Quinn, and 11 other candidates. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1929年洛杉矶市长选举于1929年6月9日举行。时任市长乔治·E·克赖尔决定不参选并退休，这是自1911年以来首次出现开放席位。约翰·克林顿·波特击败市议员威廉·G·博内利、约翰·R·奎因及另外11名候选人获胜。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）依法为无党派选举，选票上不标注候选人的党派。

en.s: The 1934 Tasmanian state election was held on 9 June 1934 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. The Nationalist Party won a huge victory in the 1931 election, but Premier of Tasmania John McPhee had resigned due to health problems, and the Nationalists were led into the 1934 election by former Premier Walter Lee.

zh.s: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州于1934年6月9日举行州选举，选出州众议院30名议员。选举采用黑尔—克拉克比例代表制，五个选区各选出6名议员。民族党在1931年大选中大胜，但塔斯马尼亚州长约翰·麦克菲因健康问题辞职，民族党改由前州长沃尔特·李率领参加1934年选举。

en.s: The Battle of the Litani River (9 June 1941) took place on the advance to Beirut during the Syria-Lebanon campaign of the Second World War. The Australian 7th Division, commanded by Major-General John Lavarack, crossed the Litani River and later clashed with Vichy French troops.

zh.s: 利塔尼河战役于1941年6月9日爆发，是第二次世界大战叙利亚—黎巴嫩战役中向贝鲁特推进的一部分。约翰·拉瓦拉克少将指挥的澳大利亚第7师渡过利塔尼河，之后与维希法国军队交战。

en.s: The Battle of Porta (Greek: Μάχη της Πόρτας) was fought on 8–9 June 1943 at the Porta and Mouzaki passes in western Thessaly, between the partisans of the Greek People's Liberation Army (ELAS) and the Royal Italian Army, during the Axis occupation of Greece. In spring 1943, a wave of successes demonstrated the rise of the Greek Resistance against the Axis powers, particularly the Italians; large areas of the mountainous interior of the country were effectively liberated.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波尔塔战役（希腊语：Μάχη της Πόρτας）于1943年6月8日至9日在希腊西色萨利的波尔塔山口和穆扎基山口爆发，交战双方是希腊人民解放军游击队和意大利皇家军队。当时希腊处于轴心国占领之下。1943年春，希腊抵抗运动接连获胜，尤其是对意大利军队的胜利，显示抵抗力量日益壮大；该国山区内陆大片地区实际上已被解放。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Ushant, also known as the Battle of Brittany, occurred on the early morning of 9 June 1944 and was an engagement between German and Allied destroyer flotillas off the coast of Brittany. The action came shortly after the initial Allied landings in Normandy. After a confused engagement during the night the Allies sank one of the German destroyers and forced another ashore, where she was wrecked.

zh.s: 乌尚岛海战又称布列塔尼海战，于1944年6月9日清晨爆发，交战双方是布列塔尼海岸外的德国与盟军驱逐舰编队。战斗发生在盟军开始登陆诺曼底后不久。夜间交战一度混乱，盟军击沉一艘德国驱逐舰，并迫使另一艘搁浅后损毁。

en.t: SS troops hang 99 men in the Tulle massacre
en.s: On June 9, 1944, soldiers of the SS Das Reich division hanged 99 men in Tulle, France, in retaliation after fighting with French Resistance forces. The victims were civilians seized in the town. Another 149 people were deported, many of whom died in captivity. Tulle commemorates the killings as a wartime atrocity.
en.n: June 9 is the day of the 99 hangings; the Resistance battle for Tulle had taken place on June 7–8.

zh.t: 党卫军在蒂勒绞死99名男子
zh.s: 1944年6月9日，纳粹德国党卫军“帝国”师在法国蒂勒绞死99名男子，以报复当地此前发生的抵抗运动战斗。遇害者是从镇上抓来的平民。另有149人被押往集中营，其中许多人未能生还。蒂勒至今纪念这场战争暴行的受害者。
zh.n: 6月9日是99人被绞死的日期；蒂勒的抵抗运动战斗发生在6月7日至8日。

en.s: The 1946 Copa del Generalísimo final was the 44th final of the Copa del Rey. The final was played at the Montjuïc, Barcelona, on 9 June 1946, being won by Real Madrid CF, who beat Valencia CF 3–1.

zh.s: 1946年国王杯决赛是该赛事第44场决赛，于1946年6月9日在巴塞罗那的蒙特惠奇球场举行。皇家马德里以3比1击败瓦伦西亚夺冠。

en.s: The 1949 Nova Scotia general election was held on 9 June 1949 to elect members of the 44th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Liberal party. The Progressive Conservatives returned to the legislature after their wipeout in the 1945 general election, but their eight seats put them in a distant second place to the Liberals' 37.

zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省于1949年6月9日举行大选，选出该省第44届众议院议员。自由党获胜。进步保守党在1945年大选中全军覆没后重返议会，但只赢得8席，远少于自由党的37席。

en.s: The 1953 British Columbia general election was the 24th general election in the Province of British Columbia, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election was called on April 10, 1953, and held on June 9, 1953. The new legislature met for the first time on September 15, 1953. The minority government formed in 1952 by the conservative Social Credit party of Premier W.A.C.

zh.s: 1953年加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省举行第24届省议会选举，选出省立法议会议员。选举于4月10日宣布，6月9日投票；新一届议会于9月15日首次开会。此前，省长W.A.C.贝内特领导的保守派社会信用党在1952年组成少数政府。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iraq on 9 June 1954, although they were delayed until 14 June in some areas due to social upheaval. The Constitutional Union Party remained the largest party in the Chamber of Deputies, winning 50 of the 135 seats, although 53 were won by independents. Despite the government creating obstacles for opposition candidates, they were described as "undoubtedly the freest elections in Iraqi history" in 2001.

zh.s: 伊拉克于1954年6月9日举行议会选举，但部分地区因社会动荡延至6月14日投票。宪政联盟党仍是众议院最大党，赢得135席中的50席；独立人士则赢得53席。尽管政府阻挠反对派候选人参选，这次选举在2001年仍被称为“毫无疑问是伊拉克历史上最自由的选举”。

en.s: The 1955 Ontario general election was held on June 9, 1955, to elect the 98 members of the 25th Legislative Assembly of Ontario (Members of Provincial Parliament, or "MPPs") of the Province of Ontario. The Ontario Progressive Conservative Party, led by Leslie Frost, won a fifth consecutive term in office, increasing its caucus in the legislature from 79 in the previous election to 83.

zh.s: 安大略省于1955年6月9日举行大选，选出安大略省第25届立法议会98名省议员。莱斯利·弗罗斯特领导的安大略省进步保守党连续第五次当选执政党，议会党团由上届的79席增加至83席。

en.t: Aeroflot Flight 105 crashes near Magadan, killing all 24 aboard
en.s: Aeroflot Flight SU105, an Ilyushin Il-12 carrying 20 passengers and four crew, crashed near Magadan during its approach from Okhotsk on June 9, 1958. The aircraft struck a wooded hillside in poor weather, killing everyone aboard. The crash site is in present-day Russia.
en.n: The crash occurred near Magadan on June 9, 1958.

zh.t: 苏联民航105号航班在马加丹附近坠毁，机上24人全部遇难
zh.s: 1958年6月9日，苏联民航SU105航班从鄂霍次克飞往马加丹，进近时在恶劣天气中撞上附近一处林木覆盖的山坡。飞机为伊尔-12型，载有20名乘客和4名机组人员，机上24人全部遇难。坠机地点如今位于俄罗斯境内。
zh.n: 这起空难于1958年6月9日在马加丹附近发生。

en.s: General elections were held in Peru on 9 June 1963 to elect the President and both houses of the Congress after the results of the 1962 elections were annulled following a military coup. Supported by Popular Action and the Christian Democrat Party, Fernando Belaúnde Terry won the presidential election with 39% of the vote, whilst the Peruvian Aprista Party emerged as the largest party in both houses of Congress. Following a coup on 3 October 1968, no further elections were held until a Constituent Assembly was elected in 1978.

zh.s: 秘鲁于1963年6月9日举行大选，选举总统和国会两院议员。1962年选举结果在军事政变后被宣布无效，因此举行此次选举。费尔南多·贝朗德·特里获得人民行动党和基督教民主党的支持，以39%的得票率赢得总统选举。秘鲁阿普拉党成为国会两院的最大党。1968年10月3日政变后，秘鲁直到1978年选出制宪议会前都没有再举行选举。

en.s: Parliamentary appointments were scheduled to be held in Ghana on 9 June 1965. As the country was a one-party state at the time, no parties except President Kwame Nkrumah's Convention People's Party (CPP), were allowed to participate. The CPP's central committee nominated 198 candidates for the 198 seats in the National Assembly, who were then declared elected without a vote taking place.

zh.s: 加纳原定于1965年6月9日举行议会选举。当时加纳实行一党制，除克瓦米·恩克鲁玛总统领导的人民大会党外，其他政党均不得参选。人民大会党中央委员会提名198名候选人竞逐国民议会的198个席位，之后所有候选人未经投票便被宣布当选。

en.s: The Battle of Đồng Xoài (Vietnamese: Trận Đồng Xoài) was a major battle fought during the Vietnam War as part of the Viet Cong (VC) Summer Offensive of 1965. It took place in Phước Long Province, South Vietnam, between 9 and 13 June 1965. Political instability in Saigon gave North Vietnamese leaders an opportunity to step up their military campaign in the south.
en.n: Vietnam War: The Viet Cong commences combat with the Army of the Republic of Vietnam in the Battle of Đồng Xoài, one of the largest battles in the war.

zh.s: 同帅战役（越南语：Trận Đồng Xoài）是越南战争期间的一场重要战役，属于1965年越共夏季攻势的一部分。战斗于1965年6月9日至13日在南越福隆省爆发。西贡政局不稳，为北越领导人加强在南方的军事行动提供了机会。
zh.n: 越南战争：越共在同帅战役中与越南共和国军交战，这是战争中规模最大的战役之一。

en.s: The 1966 Iraq Central FA Perseverance Cup was the 5th and final edition of the Iraq Central FA Perseverance Cup. The match was contested between the winners and runners-up of the 1965–66 edition of the Iraq Central FA Premier League, Al-Firqa Al-Thalitha and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya respectively. Al-Firqa Al-Thalitha won the game 1–0 with a goal by Gorgis Ismail to win the cup for the second time in their history.

zh.s: 1966年伊拉克中央足协毅力杯决赛由1965—1966赛季伊拉克中央足协超级联赛冠军Al-Firqa Al-Thalitha对阵亚军Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya。Al-Firqa Al-Thalitha以1比0获胜，Gorgis Ismail攻入制胜球，球队第二次夺得该杯。

en.s: Tel Faher or Golani Lookout is a former Syrian military outpost in the Golan Heights that has been occupied by Israel since the Six-Day War in 1967. Tel Faher was the site of an intense battle in 1967 between the Israel Defense Forces and the Syrian Army which ended in the conquest of the outpost by the Golani Brigade.The Syrian position at Tel Faher was strongly fortified with minefields, bunkers, trenches, and barbed wire protecting it.

zh.s: Tel Faher（又称戈兰尼瞭望哨）曾是戈兰高地的一处叙利亚军事据点，自1967年六日战争后由以色列占领。1967年，以色列国防军戈兰尼旅与叙利亚军队在此激战，最终攻占该据点。叙利亚阵地设有雷区、碉堡、战壕和铁丝网，防守严密。

en.s: The 1968 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1967–68 DFB-Pokal, the 25th season of Germany's premier football cup. It was played on 9 June 1968 at the Südweststadion in Ludwigshafen.

zh.s: 1968年德国足协杯决赛决出1967—68赛季德国足协杯冠军，是德国顶级足球杯赛的第25个赛季。比赛于1968年6月9日在路德维希港的西南体育场举行。

en.s: The 1971 Greek Cup final was the 27th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 9 June 1971 at Karaiskakis Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and PAOK. It was Olympiacos' seventeenth Greek Cup final in their 46 years of existence and PAOK's fifth Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 45-year history.

zh.s: 1971年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第27场决赛，于1971年6月9日在卡雷斯卡基斯体育场举行。参赛球队是奥林匹亚科斯和PAOK。奥林匹亚科斯在建队46年来第17次进入希腊杯决赛；PAOK在建队45年来第5次进入决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: The Black Hills Flood of 1972, also known as the Rapid City Flood, was the most detrimental flood in South Dakota history, and one of the deadliest floods in U.S. history. The flood took place on June 9–10, 1972 in the Black Hills of Western South Dakota. Rapid Creek and other waterways flooded due to 15 inches (380 mm) of rain in a small area over the eastern Black Hills.

zh.s: 1972年黑山洪灾又称拉皮德城洪灾，是南达科他州历史上破坏最严重的洪水，也是美国历史上最致命的洪水之一。洪灾于1972年6月9日至10日发生在南达科他州西部的黑山地区。黑山东部一小片区域降雨量达15英寸（380毫米），导致拉皮德溪及其他水道泛滥。

en.s: The 1974 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1973–74 Taça de Portugal, the 34th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 9 June 1974 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Benfica and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 1974年葡萄牙杯决赛是1973—74赛季葡萄牙杯的决赛，也是由葡萄牙足球协会组织的顶级足球杯赛第34个赛季的最后一场比赛。比赛于1974年6月9日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，对阵双方是葡萄牙顶级联赛球队本菲卡和里斯本竞技。

en.s: The 1976 Greek Cup final was the 32nd final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 9 June 1976 at Nikos Goumas Stadium. The contesting teams were Iraklis and Olympiacos. It was Iraklis' third Greek Cup final in their 68 years of existence and Olympiacos' twenty-first Greek Cup final and fourth consecutive in their 51-year history.

zh.s: 1976年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第32场决赛，于1976年6月9日在尼科斯·古马斯体育场举行。参赛球队是伊拉克利斯和奥林匹亚科斯。伊拉克利斯在建队68年来第三次进入希腊杯决赛；奥林匹亚科斯在建队51年来第21次进入决赛，也是连续第四年进入决赛。

en.s: The 1977 Ontario general election was held on June 9, 1977, to elect the 125 members of the 31st Legislative Assembly of Ontario. The Progressive Conservative Party, led by Premier Bill Davis, was re-elected for an eleventh consecutive term in office, again with a minority in the legislature. The PCs won an additional seven seats, but were not able to win a majority.

zh.s: 安大略省于1977年6月9日举行大选，选出第31届立法议会125名议员。由省长比尔·戴维斯领导的进步保守党连续第11次当选执政党，但再次未能在议会取得多数席位。该党增加7席，仍未达到多数。

en.s: The Sydney Ghost Train fire was a fire on the night of 9 June 1979 at Luna Park Sydney. The fire destroyed the amusement park's ghost train, and killed six children and one adult. Inadequate fire-fighting measures and low staffing caused the fire to completely destroy the ride, which was first constructed in 1931, and had been transported from Glenelg, South Australia to Milsons Point, New South Wales during 1934 and 1935. Although electrical faults and arson by unknown figures have been claimed, the exact cause of the fire could not be determined by a coronial inquiry.

zh.s: 1979年6月9日夜间，悉尼月神公园发生火灾，游乐园的鬼屋列车设施被烧毁，造成6名儿童和1名成年人死亡。消防措施不足、工作人员人数太少，导致这座游乐设施彻底烧毁。该设施最初于1931年建成，1934至1935年间从南澳大利亚州格莱内尔格搬到新南威尔士州米尔森角。死因调查未能确定火灾确切原因，虽然有人认为可能是电路故障或纵火。

en.s: Operation Mineral was a military operation launched by the Rhodesian Security Forces against communist guerrillas in Mozambique. The operation resulted in an ambush, which took place along a road close to Inchope in Manica Province, by the SAS on 9 June 1979. During the raid 30 guerrillas were killed by the special forces, who were also able to capture guerrilla intelligence documents and weapons as well once the ambush was finished.

zh.s: 矿石行动是罗得西亚安全部队对莫桑比克境内共产主义游击队发动的军事行动。1979年6月9日，罗得西亚空中特勤团在马尼卡省因乔佩附近一条公路上设伏。突袭中，特种部队打死30名游击队员，并缴获情报文件和武器。

en.s: The 1979 Greek Cup final was the 35th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 9 June 1979 at Karaiskakis Stadium. The contesting teams were Panionios and AEK Athens. It was Panionios' fourth Greek Cup final in their 89 years of existence and AEK Athens' eleventh Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 55-year history.

zh.s: 1979年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第35场决赛，于1979年6月9日在卡雷斯卡基斯体育场举行。参赛球队是潘尼奥尼奥斯和雅典AEK。潘尼奥尼奥斯在建队89年来第四次进入希腊杯决赛；雅典AEK在建队55年来第11次进入决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: The Italian regional elections of 1980 were held on 8 and 9 June. The fifteen ordinary regions, created in 1970, elected their third assemblies.

zh.s: 意大利大区选举于1980年6月8日和9日举行。1970年设立的15个普通大区选出了第三届议会。

en.s: Operation Mole Cricket 19 (Hebrew: מבצע ערצב-19‎‎, Mivtza ʻArtzav Tsha-Esreh) was a suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD) campaign launched by the Israeli Air Force (IAF) against Syrian targets on June 9, 1982, at the outset of the 1982 Lebanon War. The operation was the first time in history that a Western-equipped air force successfully destroyed a Soviet-built surface-to-air missile (SAM) network. It also became one of the biggest air battles since World War II, and the biggest since the Korean War. The result was a decisive Israeli victory, leading to the colloquial name the "Bekaa Valley Turkey Shoot".

zh.s: 蟋蟀19号行动（希伯来语：מבצע ערצב-19，Mivtza ʻArtzav Tsha-Esreh）是以色列空军于1982年6月9日在黎巴嫩战争初期发动的一次防空压制行动，目标是叙利亚阵地。这是历史上首次由装备西方武器的空军成功摧毁苏制地对空导弹网络。该行动也是第二次世界大战以来规模最大的空战之一，也是朝鲜战争以来规模最大的一次空战。以色列取得决定性胜利，因此该行动俗称“贝卡谷地射火鸡”。

en.s: The 1983 United Kingdom general election was held on 9 June 1983. It gave the Conservative Party under Margaret Thatcher the most decisive election victory since that of Labour in 1945. Thatcher's first four years as prime minister had not been an easy time. Unemployment increased during the first three years of her term and the economy went through a recession. However, the British victory in the Falklands War led to a recovery of her popularity; the economy had also returned to growth. By the time Thatcher called the election in May 1983, the Conservatives were most people's firm favourites to win the election.

zh.s: 英国于1983年6月9日举行大选。玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党取得压倒性胜利，这是自1945年工党获胜以来差距最大的一次。撒切尔首个四年任期并不轻松，失业率在前三年上升，经济陷入衰退。但英国在福克兰群岛战争中获胜，带动撒切尔的支持率回升，经济也恢复增长。1983年5月撒切尔宣布举行大选时，大多数人都认为保守党会获胜。

en.t: 1983 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 9 June 1983, the 1983 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 523 constituencies being in England. The Conservative Party won a landslide majority of English seats, gaining 37 seats for a total of 362. The Labour Party came second, winning 148 MPs, a decline of 45.

zh.s: 英国于1983年6月9日星期四举行大选，英格兰选区改选下议院全部650个席位中的523席。保守党在英格兰赢得压倒性多数，增加37席，共获362席。工党排名第二，赢得148席，比之前减少45席。

en.t: 1983 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on Thursday 9 June 1983 and all 72 seats in Scotland were contested. As a result of the Third Periodical Review undertaken by the Boundary Commission for Scotland the number of seats representing Scotland had increased by one from the 71 contested at the 1979 election. The Labour, Conservative and Scottish National parties all sustained modest losses in vote share to the SDP–Liberal Alliance.

zh.s: 英国于1983年6月9日星期四举行大选，苏格兰的72个席位全部改选。苏格兰选区重新划分后，席位比1979年大选时的71席增加1席。工党、保守党和苏格兰民族党的得票率均略有下降，得票转向社会民主党—自由党联盟。

en.t: 1983 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 9 June 1983, the 1983 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 38 constituencies being in Wales. The Labour Party again won a majority of Welsh MPs, but the party's vote share declined by 9.4% and they lost three seats.

zh.s: 英国于1983年6月9日星期四举行大选，威尔士选区改选下议院全部650个席位中的38席。工党再次赢得威尔士多数席位，但得票率下降9.4%，并失去3席。

en.t: 1983 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 9 June 1983, the 1983 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, including the 17 Northern Ireland seats. This was an increase of five seats, after the House of Commons (Redistribution of Seats) Act 1979 had come into effect to account for the reduced representation after direct rule had been imposed since 1972.

zh.s: 英国于1983年6月9日举行大选，北爱尔兰选区改选下议院650个席位中的17席。1979年《下议院席位重新分配法》生效后，北爱尔兰议席增加5席，以弥补1972年直接统治实施后代表权减少的情况。

en.s: General elections were held in Mali on 9 June 1985. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Democratic Union of the Malian People (UDPM) as the sole legal party. Its leader, Moussa Traoré, was the only candidate in the presidential election, and was elected unopposed. In the National Assembly elections several UDPM candidates were able to contest each seat.

zh.s: 马里于1985年6月9日举行大选。当时该国实行一党制，马里人民民主联盟是唯一合法政党。该党领袖穆萨·特拉奥雷是总统选举中的唯一候选人，未经竞争当选。在国民议会选举中，多个人民民主联盟候选人可以竞争同一个席位。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Northern Cyprus on 9 June 1985. Rauf Denktaş of the National Unity Party was re-elected with over 70% of the vote.

zh.s: 北塞浦路斯于1985年6月9日举行总统选举。民族团结党候选人拉乌夫·登克塔什以超过70%的得票率连任。

en.t: Deng Xiaoping addresses senior martial-law commanders in Beijing
en.s: On June 9, 1989, Deng Xiaoping addressed senior commanders of the military units enforcing martial law in Beijing. Speaking after the army's use of force against protesters on June 3–4, he defended the military action and said China's reform and opening-up policies would continue. Portions of the speech were shown on state television that evening.
en.n: June 9 is the date of Deng's speech to commanders; it does not establish that the military operation or its consequences ended that day.

zh.t: 邓小平在北京向戒严部队高级干部讲话
zh.s: 1989年6月9日，邓小平在北京接见执行戒严任务的部队高级干部并讲话。几天前，军队已于6月3日至4日对示威者动用武力。邓小平在讲话中支持军队的行动，并表示中国将继续实行改革开放政策。当晚，国家电视台播出了讲话片段。
zh.n: 6月9日是邓小平向戒严部队干部讲话的日期，不能据此断定军事行动及其后续影响在当天结束。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovakia on 8 and 9 June 1990 alongside federal elections. They were the first elections after the Velvet Revolution, and the first free elections since 1946. The Public Against Violence (VPN) party emerged as the largest in the Slovak National Council, winning 48 of the 150 seats. In the aftermath of the election, Vladimír Mečiar of the VPN formed a grand coalition with the Christian Democratic Movement (KDH). After a conflict leading to the dissolution of the VPN, the first Mečiar cabinet was brought down by a vote of non-confidence in the parliament.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于1990年6月8日和9日与联邦选举同时举行议会选举。这是天鹅绒革命后的首场选举，也是1946年以来首次自由选举。争取公众反对暴力党成为斯洛伐克民族议会最大党，在150席中赢得48席。选举后，该党领袖弗拉基米尔·梅恰尔与基督教民主运动组成大联合政府。争取公众反对暴力党后来发生内部分裂并解散，梅恰尔第一届内阁随后在议会不信任投票中倒台。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Czech Republic on 8 and 9 June 1990 alongside federal elections. They were the first elections after the Velvet Revolution and voter turnout was 97%. Following the elections, a coalition government was formed by Civic Forum, the Movement for Autonomous Democracy–Party for Moravia and Silesia and Christian and Democratic Union with Petr Pithart as Prime Minister.

zh.s: 捷克共和国于1990年6月8日和9日与联邦选举同时举行议会选举。这是天鹅绒革命后的首场选举，投票率达到97%。选举后，公民论坛、摩拉维亚和西里西亚自治民主运动，以及基督教民主联盟组成联合政府，由彼得·皮塔特出任总理。

en.s: Beach Brawl was the only live professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Herb Abrams' Universal Wrestling Federation (UWF). The event took place on June 9, 1991 at the Manatee Civic Center in Palmetto, Florida. Eight professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Steve Williams defeated Bam Bam Bigelow to become the inaugural SportsChannel Television Champion in the finals of a sixteen-man tournament.

zh.s: “海滩大乱斗”是赫伯·艾布拉姆斯的环球摔角联盟主办的唯一一场现场职业摔角按次付费赛事。赛事于1991年6月9日在佛罗里达州帕尔梅托的马纳提市政中心举行，共进行了八场比赛。主赛中，史蒂夫·威廉姆斯击败班班·比格罗，在16人锦标赛决赛中获胜，成为首位体育频道电视冠军。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Indonesia on 9 June 1992, to select 400 of the 500 members of the People's Representative Council (DPR). The election was the sixth legislative elections since Indonesian independence and the fifth legislative elections under the New Order regime of president Suharto. The election resulted in a clear victory for Golkar, which retained its status as the ruling party, although the opposition, under the United Development Party (PPP) and the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), saw their vote shares rise.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于1992年6月9日举行立法选举，选出人民代表委员会（DPR）500名议员中的400人。这是印度尼西亚独立后的第六次立法选举，也是苏哈托新秩序政权下的第五次立法选举。专业集团党明显获胜，继续执政；联合发展党和印度尼西亚民主党等反对派的得票率有所上升。

en.s: The Barking by-election was held on 9 June 1994, following the death of Labour Party Member of Parliament for Barking Jo Richardson. Richardson had represented the seat since the February 1974 general election, following Tom Driberg. The seat had been continuously held by Labour since it was created in 1945, and Richardson had retained her seat comfortably at the 1992 general election with an increased majority of over 6,000. Margaret Hodge, leader of Islington London Borough Council from 1982 to 1992, was selected as the Labour candidate and was the clear favourite to hold the seat at the by-election.

zh.s: 巴金选区于1994年6月9日举行补选，原因是代表该选区的工党议员乔·理查森去世。自1945年该选区设立以来，席位一直由工党把持；理查森自1974年2月大选后担任议员，并在1992年大选中以超过6,000票的优势轻松连任。伊斯灵顿区议会前领袖玛格丽特·霍奇获选为工党候选人，被普遍看好能保住席位。

en.s: The Eastleigh by-election, 1994 was a parliamentary by-election held on 9 June 1994 for the United Kingdom House of Commons constituency of Eastleigh in Hampshire. The seat had fallen vacant because of the death of Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP) Stephen Milligan on 7 February. The result of the election was a gain for the Liberal Democrats on a large swing. A disastrous result for the Conservative Party saw them fall to third place. The election was also the first election that the newly formed UK Independence Party (UKIP) stood in, with Nigel Farage as the candidate; Farage went on to become the leader of UKIP in 2006.

zh.s: 英国汉普郡伊斯特利选区于1994年6月9日举行下议院补选。保守党议员斯蒂芬·米利根于2月7日去世，导致席位空缺。自由民主党在此次选举中大幅扩大支持并赢得席位。保守党表现惨败，跌至第三位。这也是新成立的英国独立党首次参选，候选人奈杰尔·法拉奇后来于2006年成为该党领袖。

en.s: The Dagenham by-election, in Dagenham, on 9 June 1994 was held after Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Bryan Gould resigned the seat. A safe Labour seat, it was won by Judith Church, who would go on to retain the seat in 1997.

zh.s: 英国达格纳姆选区于1994年6月9日举行补选，原因是工党议员布莱恩·古尔德辞去席位。这个工党稳固选区由朱迪思·丘奇赢得，她于1997年再次保住该席位。

en.s: The Newham North East by-election, in London Borough of Newham, on 9 June 1994 was held after long-serving Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Ron Leighton died. A safe Labour seat, it was won by Stephen Timms, who would go on to retain the East Ham seat which replaced it in 1997.

zh.s: 伦敦纽汉区东北选区于1994年6月9日举行补选，原因是长期担任该区工党议员的罗恩·莱顿去世。这个工党稳固选区由斯蒂芬·蒂姆斯赢得。他后来于1997年保住了取代该选区的伊斯特哈姆席位。

en.s: The Bradford South by-election, 1994 was a by-election held in England on 9 June 1994 for the House of Commons constituency of Bradford South in West Yorkshire. The seat had become vacant on the death in a car accident on 12 April of the Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Bob Cryer, who had represented the constituency since the 1987 general election.

zh.s: 英国西约克郡布拉德福德南区于1994年6月9日举行下议院补选。工党议员鲍勃·克赖尔于4月12日在车祸中去世，导致席位空缺。他自1987年大选起一直代表该选区。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Denmark on 9 June 1994 to elect the 16 Danish members of the European Parliament.

zh.s: 丹麦于1994年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，选出16名丹麦籍欧洲议会议员。

en.s: A Dáil by-election was held in the constituency of Dublin South-Central in Ireland on Thursday, 9 June 1994, to fill a vacancy in the 27th Dáil. It followed the resignation on health grounds of Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) John O'Connell on 24 February 1993. The by-election was won by the Democratic Left candidates, Eric Byrne, a member of Dublin City Council who had represented the constituency from 1989 to 1992.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1994年6月9日星期四在都柏林南中部选区举行众议院补选，以填补第27届众议院的空缺。共和党议员约翰·奥康奈尔因健康原因于1993年2月24日辞职，因此举行补选。民主左翼候选人埃里克·伯恩获胜；他是都柏林市议会议员，曾于1989至1992年代表该选区。

en.s: A Dáil by-election was held in the constituency of Mayo West in Ireland on Thursday, 9 June 1994, to fill a vacancy in the 27th Dáil. It followed the resignation of Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) Pádraig Flynn on 4 January 1993 prior to his appointment as a European Commissioner.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1994年6月9日星期四在梅奥西部选区举行众议院补选，以填补第27届众议院的空缺。共和党议员帕德里克·弗林于1993年1月4日辞职，随后获任欧盟委员会委员。

en.t: 1994 European Parliament election in the Netherlands
en.s: An election of Members of the European Parliament representing Netherlands constituency for the 1994–1999 term of the European Parliament was held on 9 June 1994. It was part of the wider 1994 European election. Eleven parties competed in a D'Hondt type election for 31 seats (up from 25).

zh.s: 荷兰于1994年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，选出1994至1999年任期的荷兰籍欧洲议会议员。这是1994年欧洲选举的一部分。11个政党竞逐31个席位（比上届增加6席），采用洪德法计票。

en.t: 1994 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom
en.s: The 1994 European Parliament election was the fourth European election to be held in the United Kingdom. It was held on Thursday 9 June, though, as usual, the ballots were not counted until the evening of Sunday 12 June. The electoral system was, for the final European election, first past the post in England, Scotland and Wales and single transferable vote in Northern Ireland.

zh.s: 1994年英国欧洲议会选举是英国举行的第四次欧洲选举。选举于6月9日星期四举行，但与往常一样，选票直到6月12日星期日晚上才开始统计。这是英国最后一次采用简单多数制选举英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士议员；北爱尔兰则采用单记可转移投票制。

en.s: The 1994 European Parliament election in Ireland was the Irish component of the 1994 European Parliament election. The election was conducted under the single transferable vote. Local elections were held on the same day for borough councils, urban district councils and town commissioners.

zh.s: 1994年爱尔兰欧洲议会选举是该届欧洲议会选举在爱尔兰举行的部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制。同日还举行了地方选举，选出自治市议会、城市区议会和镇委员。

en.s: Ansett New Zealand Flight 703 was a scheduled flight from Auckland to Palmerston North. On 9 June 1995, the de Havilland Canada Dash 8-100 aircraft crashed into the Tararua Range on approach to Palmerston North. The flight attendant and three passengers died as a result of the crash; the two pilots and 15 passengers survived.

zh.t: 安塞特新西兰航空703号班机空难
zh.s: 安塞特新西兰航空703号班机原定从奥克兰飞往北帕默斯顿。1995年6月9日，飞机在接近北帕默斯顿时撞上塔拉鲁阿山脉。空难造成空乘人员和3名乘客死亡；两名飞行员和15名乘客幸存。

en.s: The Military Technical Agreement, also known as the Kumanovo Agreement, signed between the International Security Force (KFOR) and the Governments of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Serbia, was an accord concluded on 9 June 1999 in Kumanovo, Macedonia. It resulted in the end of the Kosovo War, and established new basic relations between Yugoslavia and the Kosovo Force, which would replace units of the Yugoslav Army in Kosovo.

zh.s: 《军事技术协议》又称《库马诺沃协议》，于1999年6月9日在马其顿库马诺沃签署，签约方是国际安全部队（KFOR）以及南斯拉夫联盟共和国和塞尔维亚政府。协议结束了科索沃战争，并确立了南斯拉夫与科索沃部队之间新的基本关系；科索沃部队将取代驻科索沃的南斯拉夫军队。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 9 and 16 June 2002, to elect the 12th National Assembly of the Fifth Republic, in a context of political crisis. The Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin announced his political retirement after his elimination at the first round of the 2002 presidential elections. President Jacques Chirac was easily reelected, all the Republican parties having called to block far-right leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国于2002年6月9日和16日举行立法选举，选出第五共和国第12届国民议会。当时法国处于政治危机之中：社会党总理利昂内尔·若斯潘在2002年总统选举首轮落选后宣布退出政坛。总统雅克·希拉克轻松连任，各共和党均呼吁选民阻止极右翼领袖让-马里·勒庞当选。

en.s: The 2003 New Brunswick general election was held on June 9, 2003, to elect the 55 members of the 55th New Brunswick Legislative Assembly. Although early polls suggested a landslide victory for the incumbent Progressive Conservatives of Premier Bernard Lord, the dynamics of the race shifted after Shawn Graham, leader of the Liberal Party, made auto insurance rates a key issue of his campaign.

zh.s: 新不伦瑞克省于2003年6月9日举行大选，选出该省第55届立法议会55名议员。早期民调显示，由省长伯纳德·洛德领导的执政进步保守党可能压倒性获胜；但自由党领袖肖恩·格雷厄姆将汽车保险费率作为竞选重点后，选情发生变化。

en.s: Operation Peninsula Strike was a series of raids conducted by American troops from 9 to 13 June 2003 as part of Operation Iraqi Freedom, carried out by members of Task Force Ironhorse on a peninsula alongside the Tigris River near Balad, Iraq. In the operation US forces sought to target members of the Ba'ath Party, paramilitary, and subversive units.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 半岛突击行动是美国军队于2003年6月9日至13日发动的一系列突袭，是“伊拉克自由行动”的一部分。行动由“铁马”特遣队在伊拉克巴拉德附近底格里斯河畔的半岛地区执行，目标是复兴党成员、准军事组织和颠覆活动团体。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Voting concludes in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia regional election
en.s: Voting in Italy's Friuli-Venezia Giulia regional election took place on June 8 and 9, 2003. Riccardo Illy, an independent backed by the centre-left, defeated Alessandra Guerra of the Northern League in the contest for regional president. Voters also chose the regional council.
en.n: June 9 was the second and final voting day; polling began on June 8.

zh.t: 意大利弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚大区选举结束投票
zh.s: 2003年6月8日至9日，意大利弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚大区举行选举。得到中左翼支持的独立候选人里卡尔多·伊利击败北方联盟的亚历山德拉·圭拉，当选大区主席。选民也选出了大区议会。
zh.n: 6月9日是第二个、也是最后一个投票日；投票从6月8日开始。

en.s: Strikeforce: Revenge was the second mixed martial arts event promoted by Strikeforce. The event took place at the HP Pavilion at San Jose in San Jose, California on June 9, 2006. The main event featured the North American debut of Alistair Overeem.

zh.s: Strikeforce：复仇是Strikeforce主办的第二场综合格斗赛事，于2006年6月9日在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的HP展馆举行。主赛是阿里斯泰尔·欧沃瑞姆首次在北美参赛。

en.s: The 2007 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Team Bath and Galleria Mavericks. Team Bath would eventually retain the title but in the grand final it was Mavericks who started the stronger and were leading 10–12 after the first quarter and 21–22 at half time. Both Rachel Dunn and Pamela Cookey initially underperformed for Team Bath.

zh.t: 2007年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2007年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由Team Bath和Galleria Mavericks对阵。Team Bath最终卫冕冠军，但Mavericks开局更强，首节以12比10、半场以22比21领先。Team Bath的Rachel Dunn和Pamela Cookey起初发挥不佳。

en.s: The 2008 Beni Amrane bombings were two bombings on June 9, 2008 that killed 13 people in the town of Beni Amrane in the Boumerdès Province, 50 km (31 mi) from Algiers, the capital of Algeria. The first bomb killed a French citizen and his Algerian driver as they were leaving the town's railway station. The second device exploded about five minutes later as rescue workers arrived. Eight soldiers and three firefighters died in the second blast while an unconfirmed number of people suffered injuries. Both devices appeared to have been detonated remotely.

zh.s: 2008年6月9日，阿尔及利亚布迈尔德省贝尼阿姆拉内镇发生两起爆炸，造成13人死亡。该镇距首都阿尔及尔50公里。第一枚炸弹炸死一名法国公民和他的阿尔及利亚司机，当时两人正离开镇上的火车站。约五分钟后，救援人员抵达现场，第二枚炸弹爆炸，造成8名士兵和3名消防员死亡；另有不明人数受伤。两枚炸弹似乎都是远程引爆的。

en.s: The Pearl Continental hotel bombing occurred on 9 June 2009 in Peshawar, Pakistan, in which 17 people were killed and at least 46 people injured. The blast occurred at the five-star Pearl Continental hotel in the city. The force of the explosion caused the hotel to partially collapse. Gunman also attacked the hotel, firing several shots at survivors. The United States had planned to purchase this hotel to convert it to a consulate. Malik Naveed, a provincial police chief, stated that at least 11 people had died but that the death toll was likely to rise. At least 46 others have been injured.

zh.s: 2009年6月9日，巴基斯坦白沙瓦的珍珠大陆酒店发生爆炸，造成17人死亡、至少46人受伤。爆炸发生在市内的五星级珍珠大陆酒店，冲击力导致酒店部分坍塌。持枪者还袭击酒店，向幸存者开枪。美国曾计划购买这家酒店并改建为领事馆。省警察局长马利克·纳维德当时表示，至少11人死亡，并预计死亡人数还会增加；至少另有46人受伤。

en.s: The 2009 Nova Scotia general election was held on June 9, 2009 to elect members of the 61st House of Assembly of the Province of Nova Scotia, Canada. The government was defeated on a money bill on May 4, and the Nova Scotia House of Assembly was dissolved by Lieutenant Governor Mayann Francis on May 5. thereby triggering an election.

zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省于2009年6月9日举行大选，选出该省第61届众议院议员。政府于5月4日在一项拨款法案上失利，副总督梅扬·弗朗西斯于5月5日解散新斯科舍省众议院，从而触发大选。

en.s: The Nadahan wedding bombing was a suicide attack on a wedding party, which occurred on 9 June 2010 at around 21:00 local time (16:30 GMT) in the village of Nadahan in Arghandab District of the Kandahar Province, Afghanistan. The attack killed at least 40 people and wounded at least 77 others, making it one of the worst suicide attacks of the year.

zh.s: 纳达汉婚礼爆炸案是一起自杀式袭击，于2010年6月9日当地时间约21时（格林尼治标准时间16时30分）发生在阿富汗坎大哈省阿尔甘达布区纳达汉村的一场婚礼上。袭击造成至少40人死亡、至少77人受伤，是当年最严重的自杀式袭击之一。

en.t: Liberal Democrat MPs elect Simon Hughes as deputy leader
en.s: Liberal Democrat MPs voted in the party's deputy leadership election. Simon Hughes won the ballot, following Vince Cable's resignation from the post.
en.n: Deputy-leadership ballot.

zh.t: 自由民主党议员选举西蒙·休斯为副党魁
zh.s: 自由民主党议员投票选举党内副党魁。文斯·凯布尔辞去这一职务后，西蒙·休斯赢得选举。
zh.n: 副党魁选举投票。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Belfast West was held on 9 June 2011, prompted by the resignation of the incumbent Sinn Féin Member of Parliament (MP) Gerry Adams to contest the Louth constituency in the 2011 Irish general election. It was won by Paul Maskey, who held the seat for Sinn Féin.

zh.s: 英国贝尔法斯特西区议会选区于2011年6月9日举行补选。新芬党议员杰里·亚当斯辞去席位，准备参加2011年爱尔兰大选中的劳斯选区竞选，因此举行补选。保罗·马斯基赢得席位，继续为新芬党守住该选区。

en.s: The 2011 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Hertfordshire Mavericks and Surrey Storm. Mavericks would win their second title. This was Mavericks sixth successive grand final while Surrey Storm's were making their debut appearance. Between 2011 and 2016 Surrey Storm would play in five out of the six Netball Superleague grand finals. However in their first three they finished as runners up. In 2011 they lost 57–46 to Mavericks.

zh.t: 2011年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2011年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由赫特福德郡Mavericks对阵萨里Storm。Mavericks第二次夺冠；这是球队连续第六次打进总决赛，而萨里Storm首次闯入决赛。2011至2016年间，萨里Storm六届总决赛参加了五届，前三次均获亚军；2011年以46比57负于Mavericks。

en.s: The 2012 Christy Ring Cup final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 9 June 2012 to determine the winners of the 2012 Christy Ring Cup, the 8th season of the Christy Ring Cup, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the second tier hurling teams. The final was contested by London of Britain and Wicklow of Leinster, with London winning by 4-18 to 1-17.

zh.s: 2012年克里斯蒂·林杯决赛是2012年该赛事的决赛，于2012年6月9日在克罗克公园举行。该赛事是盖尔运动协会为二级爱尔兰式曲棍球（hurling）球队组织的锦标赛，2012年为第八届。来自英国的伦敦队对阵来自伦斯特的威克洛队，伦敦队以4比18比1比17获胜。

en.s: Elections were held in Split, Croatia, on 9 June 2014 for the councils of 34 city districts and local committees of Split. The Croatian Democratic Union coalition won 98 council seats, an absolute majority in 10 districts and a relative majority in 6 districts. The Social Democratic Party of Croatia coalition won 45 seats.

zh.s: 克罗地亚斯普利特于2014年6月9日举行选举，改选该市34个区和地方委员会。克罗地亚民主共同体联盟赢得98个议席，在10个区取得绝对多数，在6个区取得相对多数。克罗地亚社会民主党联盟赢得45席。

en.s: On 9 June 2015, India conducted a cross-border strike, code named Operation Hot Pursuit, against insurgents belonging to NSCN-K. The operation took place in Myanmar and it was in response to ambush of Indian Army convoy of 6 Dogra Regiment in Chandel district of Manipur. Indian officials said that Indian Army Special Forces had crossed the border and inflicted significant casualties against the NSCN-K.

zh.t: 2015年印度在缅甸的反叛乱行动
zh.s: 2015年6月9日，印度发动代号为“热烈追击行动”的跨境打击，目标是那加兰民族社会主义委员会—卡普朗派的叛乱分子。行动在缅甸境内实施，是对该组织伏击印度陆军曼尼普尔邦钱德尔县第6多格拉团车队的回应。印度官员称，印度陆军特种部队越境行动，给卡普朗派造成重大伤亡。

en.s: The 2017 Superclásico de las Américas – Copa Doctor Nicolás Leoz was the fourth edition of the Superclásico de las Américas, an annual friendly football match between the national teams of Argentina and Brazil. The match was played at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in Melbourne, Australia. Argentina won the match by the solitary goal scored by Gabriel Mercado in the 45th minute of the first half, thus winning Superclásico de las Américas for the first time.

zh.s: 2017年美洲超级德比（尼古拉斯·莱奥斯博士杯）是阿根廷和巴西国家队之间年度友谊赛的第四届。比赛在澳大利亚墨尔本板球场举行。阿根廷凭借加布里埃尔·梅尔卡多在上半场第45分钟的进球，以1比0获胜，首次赢得这项赛事。

en.s: UFC 225: Whittaker vs. Romero 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on June 9, 2018, at the United Center in Chicago, Illinois.

zh.s: UFC 225：惠特克对阵罗梅罗二番战是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2018年6月9日在伊利诺伊州芝加哥的联合中心举行。

en.s: On June 9, 2018, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin attacked Malian forces in the town of Boni, Mali.

zh.s: 2018年6月9日，伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织的圣战分子袭击了马里博尼镇的马里军队。

en.s: The 2018 Northcote by-election was a New Zealand by-election that was held in Northcote on 9 June 2018. The seat became vacant on 15 April 2018, following the resignation of then-Member for Northcote Jonathan Coleman, a member of the New Zealand National Party. National Party candidate Dan Bidois retained the seat for National, but with a significantly reduced majority blamed on low voter turnout; it was therefore described as a victory for the National Party Leader Simon Bridges.

zh.s: 新西兰诺斯科特选区于2018年6月9日举行补选。时任议员乔纳森·科尔曼是新西兰国家党成员，他于4月15日辞职，导致席位空缺。国家党候选人丹·比多伊斯赢得席位，为该党保住了诺斯科特，但多数优势大幅缩小。有人将结果归咎于投票率偏低，因此称这是国家党领袖西蒙·布里奇斯的胜利。

en.s: The 2019 UEFA Nations League final was a football match that determined the winners of the final tournament of the 2018–19 UEFA Nations League. It was the inaugural final of the international football competition involving the men's national teams of the member associations of UEFA. The match was held on 9 June 2019 at the Estádio do Dragão in Porto, Portugal, and was contested by hosts Portugal and the Netherlands.

zh.s: 2019年欧足联国家联赛决赛是一场足球比赛，决出2018—19赛季赛事的冠军。这是欧足联成员协会男子国家队参加的这项国际赛事的首场决赛。比赛于2019年6月9日在葡萄牙波尔图的巨龙球场举行，由东道主葡萄牙对阵荷兰。

en.s: Snap presidential elections were held in Kazakhstan on 9 June 2019 to elect the President of Kazakhstan following the resignation of long-term President Nursultan Nazarbayev in March 2019. This was the sixth presidential election held since Kazakhstan's independence. The elections were not free nor fair, and were widely denounced as a sham. Acting president Kassym-Jomart Tokayev of Nur Otan won the election.

zh.s: 哈萨克斯坦于2019年6月9日举行提前总统选举，此前长期执政的总统努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫于当年3月辞职。这是哈萨克斯坦独立以来的第六次总统选举。选举并不自由、公正，受到广泛谴责，被指为一场骗局。代总统、祖国之光党候选人卡西姆若马尔特·托卡耶夫赢得选举。

en.s: The 2020 West Virginia Republican presidential primary was held on June 9, 2020, along with the Georgia primary on the same day. All 35 of West Virginia's delegates to the 2020 Republican National Convention were allocated according to the results. Donald Trump won the primary and all of the state's delegates.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选于2020年6月9日举行，与同日举行的佐治亚州初选同步。西弗吉尼亚州共和党全国代表大会的35名代表全部按初选结果分配。唐纳德·特朗普赢得初选，并获得该州全部代表。

en.s: The 2020 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary was held on June 9, 2020 alongside the Georgia primary, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. It was originally scheduled for May 12, 2020, but was moved to June 9 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选于2020年6月9日举行，与佐治亚州初选同步，是民主党2020年总统初选的一部分。初选原定于2020年5月12日举行，后因新冠疫情改至6月9日。

en.s: The 2020 Georgia Republican presidential primary took place on June 9, 2020, as one of 2 contests scheduled for that day in the Republican Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election.

zh.t: 2020年佐治亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年佐治亚州共和党总统初选于2020年6月9日举行，是共和党2020年总统初选中当天举行的两场竞选之一。

en.s: The 2020 Georgia Democratic presidential primary was held on June 9, 2020, alongside the West Virginia primary, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. It was originally scheduled for March 24, 2020, but was moved to June 9 due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and previously cast early mail-in votes were disallowed and separately counted.

zh.t: 2020年佐治亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年佐治亚州民主党总统初选于2020年6月9日与西弗吉尼亚州初选同时举行，是民主党2020年总统初选的一部分。初选原定于2020年3月24日举行，后因新冠疫情改至6月9日；此前投出的邮寄提前选票被作废，并另行计票。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mongolia on 9 June 2021. The result was a victory for former prime minister Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh of the Mongolian People's Party (MPP), who received 72% of the valid vote. The elections were considered free and fair by OSCE. However, there was controversy as several opposition candidates were disqualified and former president Khaltmaagiin Battulga was barred from running for a second term.

zh.s: 蒙古于2021年6月9日举行总统选举。蒙古人民党前总理乌赫那·呼日勒苏赫以72%的有效票获胜。欧洲安全与合作组织认为选举自由、公正。不过，多名反对派候选人被取消资格，前总统哈勒特马·巴特图勒嘎也被禁止竞选第二个任期，因此选举引发争议。

en.s: Rise of the Renegades (2022) was a special episode of MLW Fusion that aired on June 9, 2022. Though it shares the same name as the reoccurring Rise of the Renegades professional wrestling event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), the matches featured on the program were taped as part of the Azteca Underground event held at Gilley's Dallas in Dallas, Texas on April 1, 2022.

zh.s: 《叛逆者崛起》（2022年）是MLW Fusion的一期特别节目，于2022年6月9日播出。虽然节目与美国职业摔角联盟举办的年度赛事同名，但节目中的比赛是在2022年4月1日于得克萨斯州达拉斯的Gilley's Dallas录制的，属于阿兹特克地下赛事。

en.s: Road to UFC Season 1 is the 2022 cycle of Road to UFC, a mixed martial arts event series in which top Asian MMA prospects compete to win contracts with the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). It features four divisions—flyweight, bantamweight, featherweight and lightweight—each for which eight fighters compete in a "win-and-advance" tournament format. The tournament winner for each division is awarded a UFC contract. Each event in the series features five bouts including one non-tournament bout. The opening quarterfinal round of the tournament was held across two days, June 9–10, 2022 at Singapore Indoor Stadium, with two five-bout events for each day for a total of 10 bouts per day, ahead of the pay-per-view event UFC 275 on June 11.

zh.s: 《通往UFC》第一季是2022年举办的一系列赛事。亚洲顶尖综合格斗新秀参赛，争夺终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）合约。比赛分为蝇量级、雏量级、羽量级和轻量级四个级别，每个级别有8名选手采用“赢了晋级”的赛制角逐。各级别冠军都将获得UFC合约。每场赛事有5场比赛，其中1场不计入锦标赛。锦标赛首轮四分之一决赛于2022年6月9日至10日在新加坡室内体育馆举行，连续两天每天举办两场赛事，每场5场比赛、每天共10场，随后于6月11日举行UFC 275按次付费赛事。

en.s: The clashes in the western Democratic Republic of the Congo are a series of attacks by Mobondo militia on armed forces (FARDC) and Teke civilians which started in June 2022. The conflict has an ethnic component, as the Mobondo is mainly recruited from Yaka and other ethnic groups that are migrating into territories traditionally inhabited by Teke.

zh.s: 2022年6月起，刚果民主共和国西部发生一系列冲突：莫邦多民兵袭击政府军和特克族平民。这场冲突带有族群因素，莫邦多民兵主要从迁入特克族传统居住地区的雅卡族等族群中招募人员。

en.s: The 2023 Against All Odds was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on June 9, 2023, at the Ohio Expo Center in Columbus, Ohio, and aired on Impact Plus and YouTube. It was the 12th event under the Against All Odds chronology. Eleven matches were contested at the event, including two on the pre-show and one taped as a digital exclusive.

zh.s: 2023年《不惜一切代价》是Impact Wrestling主办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2023年6月9日在俄亥俄州哥伦布市的俄亥俄博览中心举行，并通过Impact Plus和YouTube播出。这是该系列第12场赛事，共进行了11场比赛，其中两场在预演环节举行，另有一场作为数字独家内容录制。

en.s: In June 2023, a battle took place around the village of Mala Tokmachka as part of the 2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive and during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Lithuania were held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the first to take place after Brexit.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是英国脱欧后举行的首场此类选举。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament elections in Cyprus was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the fifth parliamentary election since Cyprus's EU accession in 2004. The centre-right Democratic Rally (DISY), which has won every previous election to this body, emerged victorious again with 24.8% of the votes, securing 2 seats. The communist party AKEL followed with 21.5% and 1 seat.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是塞浦路斯自2004年加入欧盟以来的第五次欧洲议会选举。此前每届选举都获胜的中右翼民主联盟再次胜出，获得24.8%的选票和2个席位。共产党AKEL以21.5%的选票排名第二，获得1席。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Greece was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the first to take place after Brexit. The governing New Democracy came first, but ceded ground in terms of both popular vote and seats secured. The centre-left SYRIZA and PASOK came in second and third, respectively: SYRIZA lost two seats, while PASOK gained one.

zh.s: 希腊于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分，也是英国脱欧后举行的首场此类选举。执政的新民主党仍排名第一，但得票率和席位数均下滑。中左翼激进左翼联盟和泛希腊社会主义运动分别排名第二和第三：激进左翼联盟减少2席，泛希腊社会主义运动增加1席。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Poland was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the first to take place after Brexit. The elections were won by the Civic Coalition, the largest governing bloc. Together with its coalition partners Third Way and The Left, the ruling coalition won a combined majority of votes and seats.

zh.s: 波兰于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分，也是英国脱欧后举行的首场此类选举。最大执政联盟公民联盟赢得选举。执政联盟连同合作伙伴第三条道路和左翼，合计赢得多数选票和席位。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Finland to the European Parliament took place on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the seventh European Parliament election held in Finland, and the first to take place after Brexit. Finnish voters elected fifteen members from seven national parties to the European Parliament.

zh.s: 芬兰于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会代表选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是芬兰第七次举行欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。芬兰选民从7个全国性政党中选出15名欧洲议会议员。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Belgium was held on 9 June 2024 in the three Belgian constituencies (the Dutch-speaking electoral college, the French-speaking electoral college and the German-speaking electoral college) to elect the Belgian delegation to the European Parliament. It is part of the 2024 European Parliament election and the 2024 Belgian elections. It was the tenth European Parliament election held in Belgium, and the first to take place after Brexit.

zh.s: 比利时于2024年6月9日在三个选区举行欧洲议会选举，选出比利时代表团，包括荷兰语选举团、法语选举团和德语选举团。该选举是2024年欧洲议会选举和比利时大选的一部分。这是比利时第十次举行欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament elections in France were held on 9 June 2024, as part of the 2024 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 法国于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Austria was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the seventh European Parliament election held in Austria, and the first to take place after Brexit. The Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ), by winning the European Parliament election with 25.4%, won its first ever nationwide election in Austria.

zh.s: 奥地利于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是奥地利第七次举行欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。奥地利自由党以25.4%的得票率赢得选举，这是该党首次在奥地利全国性选举中获胜。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Slovenia was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the fifth European Parliament election held in Slovenia, and the first to take place after Brexit.

zh.t: 2024年斯洛文尼亚欧洲议会选举
zh.s: 斯洛文尼亚于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是斯洛文尼亚第五次举行欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament elections in Hungary were held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the first European election to take place after Brexit and on the same day as local elections. This was the first nationwide election contested by the Tisza Party under Péter Magyar, who became the most popular opposition figure to then-Prime Minister Viktor Orbán since the Novák scandal broke in February 2024.

zh.s: 匈牙利于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，同时举行地方选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行的欧洲选举。这是蒂萨党由彼得·马扎尔领导以来首次参加全国选举。自2024年2月诺瓦克丑闻曝光以来，马扎尔成为挑战时任总理维克托·欧尔班的最受欢迎反对派人物。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Italy took place on 8 and 9 June 2024, electing members of the 10th Italian delegation to the European Parliament as part of the broader 2024 European Parliament election from 6 to 9 June. It was held concurrently with the 2024 Italian local elections.

zh.s: 意大利于2024年6月8日和9日举行欧洲议会选举，选出第十届意大利代表团成员，是2024年欧洲议会选举（6月6日至9日）的一部分。选举与2024年意大利地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Brandenburg local elections were held on June 9, 2024 to elect members of Brandenburg's 14 district councils and 4 independent city councils. Voters also elected members of 409 municipal councils. The elections were held on the same day as the 2024 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 勃兰登堡于2024年6月9日举行地方选举，改选14个县议会和4个独立市议会的议员。选民还选出409个市镇议会议员。此次选举与德国2024年欧洲议会选举在同一天举行。

en.s: An election was held in Spain on 9 June 2024 as part of the concurrent EU-wide election to the 10th European Parliament. All 61 seats allocated to the Spanish constituency as per the Treaty of Lisbon and the 2023 Council Decision establishing the composition of the European Parliament were up for election.

zh.s: 西班牙于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是欧盟范围内第十届欧洲议会选举的一部分。根据《里斯本条约》和2023年欧盟理事会关于欧洲议会组成的决定，西班牙选区分配的61个席位全部改选。

en.s: The 2024 Budapest mayoral election was held on 9 June 2024 to elect the mayor of Budapest (főpolgármester). The elected mayor only took office in October. On the same day, local elections were held throughout Hungary, including the districts of Budapest which will determine the composition of the General Assembly. The election was run using a first-past-the-post voting system.

zh.s: 布达佩斯于2024年6月9日举行选举，选出市长。胜选者直到10月才就任。同一天，匈牙利各地举行地方选举，包括布达佩斯各区选举，以决定总议会组成。此次选举采用简单多数制。

en.s: The 2024 Hamburg borough elections were held on 9 June 2024, the same day of the European elections. Parties and electoral lists had to be registered with the borough returning office between 3 July 2023 and 2 April 2024.

zh.s: 汉堡区议会选举于2024年6月9日举行，与欧洲议会选举同日。各政党和选举名单须在2023年7月3日至2024年4月2日期间向区选举办公室登记。

en.s: The 2024 Limassol Municipal election was a municipal election that took place in Limassol on June 9, 2024, alongside the 2024 European elections and other local elections. These elections had been postponed from December 2021 pending local government reform. Independent candidate Yiannis Armeftis ultimately won the mayorship with 48.5% of the votes.

zh.s: 利马索尔于2024年6月9日举行市政选举，与2024年欧洲议会选举及其他地方选举同时进行。此次选举原定于2021年12月举行，因地方政府改革而推迟。独立候选人扬尼斯·阿尔梅夫蒂斯最终以48.5%的得票率当选市长。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Sweden were held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the seventh European Parliament election held in Sweden, and the first to take place after Brexit.

zh.s: 瑞典于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是瑞典第七次举行欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。

en.s: An election was held in Portugal on Sunday, 9 June 2024, to elect the Portuguese delegation to the European Parliament from 2024 to 2029. It took place as part of the wider 2024 European Parliament election. This was the ninth European Parliament election held in Portugal. This election took place just three months after the 10 March 2024 legislative election, which resulted in a very narrow win for the Democratic Alliance, thus was seen as a "second round" of the March elections.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于2024年6月9日星期日举行选举，选出2024至2029年任期的葡萄牙籍欧洲议会议员。这是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分，也是葡萄牙第九次举行欧洲议会选举。此次选举距2024年3月10日立法选举仅三个月；民主联盟在该选举中以微弱优势获胜，因此本次选举被视为那次选举的“第二轮”。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament elections in Croatia were held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the fourth parliamentary election since Croatia's EU accession in 2013, and the first to take place after Brexit. It is the second election in 2024, the "superelection year" for Croatia, following the April parliamentary election and preceding the presidential election.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是克罗地亚2013年加入欧盟以来的第四次欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。2024年是克罗地亚的“超级选举年”，此前4月举行议会选举，此后还将举行总统选举。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Romania was held on 9 June 2024. This was the fifth European Parliament election to be held in Romania since the country's accession to the European Union in 2007 and the first since Brexit.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举。这是罗马尼亚自2007年加入欧盟以来的第五次欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament elections in Luxembourg were held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the first to take place after Brexit.

zh.s: 卢森堡于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分，也是英国脱欧后首次举行的此类选举。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election in Bulgaria was held on 9 June 2024 as part of the 2024 European Parliament election. This was the country’s fifth parliamentary election since its accession to the EU in 2007, and the first to take place after Brexit. Bulgaria also held a separate national parliamentary election that day.

zh.s: 保加利亚于2024年6月9日举行欧洲议会选举，是欧盟范围内2024年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是保加利亚2007年加入欧盟以来的第五次议会选举，也是英国脱欧后首次举行。保加利亚同一天还举行了另一场全国议会选举。

en.s: The 2024 Baden-Württemberg local elections were held on June 9, 2024, to elect members of Baden-Württemberg's 35 district councils and 1101 municipal and local councils. The elections were held on the same day as the 2024 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 巴登-符腾堡州于2024年6月9日举行地方选举，改选该州35个县议会以及1,101个市镇和地方议会的议员。此次选举与德国2024年欧洲议会选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 NXT Battleground (marketed as NXT Battleground: Las Vegas), was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the second annual Battleground held for the promotion's developmental brand NXT, and the seventh Battleground overall. In partnership with Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), WWE's sister company under TKO Group Holdings, the event took place on June 9, 2024, at the UFC Apex in the Las Vegas suburb of Enterprise, Nevada, marking WWE's first event held at the venue.

zh.s: 2024年NXT战场（宣传名称为“NXT战场：拉斯维加斯”）是WWE主办的职业摔角直播赛事。这是WWE旗下发展品牌NXT第二次举办战场赛事，也是该系列第七场赛事。WWE与同属TKO集团的姐妹公司终极格斗冠军赛合作，于2024年6月9日在内华达州拉斯维加斯郊区恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，成为WWE首次在该场馆举办赛事。

en.s: The 2024 European Parliament election was held in the European Union (EU) between 6 and 9 June 2024. It was the tenth parliamentary election since the first direct elections in 1979, and the first European Parliament election after Brexit. A total of 720 members of the European Parliament (MEPs) were elected to represent more than 450 million people from 27 member states.

zh.s: 欧盟于2024年6月6日至9日举行欧洲议会选举。这是自1979年首次直接选举以来的第十次欧洲议会选举，也是英国脱欧后的首次。27个成员国超过4.5亿名居民选出720名欧洲议会议员。

en.s: The 2024 Gatineau mayoral by-election was held on June 9, 2024, to elect the 23rd mayor of Gatineau, Quebec, Canada, to serve the remainder of the 2021 to 2025 term following the resignation of mayor France Bélisle, who resigned effective immediately on February 22, 2024, citing a toxic political environment and death threats. Maude Marquis-Bissonnette of Action Gatineau won the election with 41.7 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省加蒂诺市于2024年6月9日举行市长补选，选出第23任市长，完成2021至2025年任期。时任市长弗朗斯·贝利斯以政治环境恶劣并收到死亡威胁为由，于2024年2月22日立即辞职。加蒂诺行动党的莫德·马基-比松内特以41.7%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 2024 Saarland local elections were held on June 9, 2024 to elect members of Saarland's 6 district councils and 52 municipal councils. The elections were held on the same day as the 2024 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 萨尔州于2024年6月9日举行地方选举，改选该州6个县议会和52个市镇议会议员。选举与德国2024年欧洲议会选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Belgian regional elections were held on Sunday 9 June, the same day as the 2024 European Parliament election as well as the Belgian federal election. In the regional elections, new representatives are chosen for the Flemish Parliament, Walloon Parliament, Brussels Parliament and the Parliament of the German-speaking Community.

en.s: The 2024 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match that was played on 9 June at Semple Stadium in Thurles. It was contested by defending champions Limerick and Clare. The game was televised live on RTÉ 2 as part of The Sunday Game, presented by Joanne Cantwell. Commentary on the game was provided by Marty Morrissey, alongside Brendan Cummins.

en.s: An election for the Members of the European Parliament from Estonia as part of the 2024 European Parliament election took place on 9 June. Early voting took place from 3 June to 8 June. en.s: In June 2024, the Chin Brotherhood Alliance, a military alliance of several Chin ethnic organisations, launched Operation Chin Brotherhood, shortened to Operation CB, an operation to capture regions which the CBA is active in. This operation has been aided by several non-Chin groups, notably the Rakhine-led Arakan Army and the Magway Region-based Yaw Army. During the offensives, five town's have been captured by the CBA: Matupi, Lailenpi, Mindat, Kanpetlet, and Falam.
